fichas.title: Greenhouse equipment and ventilation
fichas.summary: Illustrated greenhouse equipment includes roof and side ventilation, mechanical window opening, exterior blinds, humidification, air circulation, irrigation, heating, insulation, plant and propagation beds, lighting, and humidity and temperature controls. Ventilation should bring the interior temperature close to the outside temperature when opened; about 20% of the roof area should open. External sun protection is more effective when spaced sufficiently far from the glass.

dimensions.label: Opening roof area
dimensions.context: Approximate proportion of roof area that should open for ventilation.
dimensions.ocr_raw: about 20% of the roof area opens as a ventilation band or a single casement
